headline: No budget moves: LinkedIn stays paused, Meta sits just above the 1.5 ROAS target (1.59 last-click) and gets a holdout test, and the direct surge keeps fading (71 to 45 per week).

tests.hypothesis: Meta's last-click CPA rose from about $60 to $98 since 2026-10-02 (last 7 days: ROAS 1.59 vs 1.5 target), but models give it 2.6 to 4.1 ROAS. A holdout will show whether it is still incremental or only catching clicks.
tests.design: Geo holdout: pause Meta in about 20% of matched regions for 3 to 4 weeks. Measure total conversions, including direct and self-reported 'Instagram or Facebook ad', in held-out vs control regions. If total conversions in held-out regions drop by less than the roughly 25 conversions per week Meta claims (pro-rated), cut Meta. If they drop by that much or more, keep the budget.

flag_verdicts.reason: Meta CPA is $98 vs $60 before 10-02, but the last 3 weeks ($96) match the weeks just before them ($92), so it is a level shift and not a worsening trend. Last-week ROAS is 1.59 vs the 1.5 target, and the models give 2.6 to 4.1. Under the rules it is not a cut. Holdout test recommended.

Already handled. LinkedIn had 0 conversions on $2,446 and $2,582 in the two weeks of 10-19 and 10-26, and has been paused since (0 spend for 3 weeks). Keep it paused. The models' 1.6 to 2.3 ROAS comes from tracked touches in earlier weeks, not from recent results.
The September 12 to 18 Google spend spike is over. CPA held at $21 vs $18. Recent Google CPA is $16.8 and ROAS 11.7.

Direct fell from 71 (week of 10-26) to 45 (week of 11-16). Self-reported ChatGPT/AI answers are still elevated, at 15% for ChatGPT and 3% for other AI assistants in the latest week, vs about 4% combined in August. This looks like an untracked AI-driven effect. It is not credit for any paid channel, and no paid budget should move on it.

flags.message: meta CPA rose 1.6x, from $60 to $98, starting 2026-10-02.
linkedin CPA rose 19.1x, from $148 to $2825, starting 2026-10-17.
google_search spend jumped for 7 days (2026-09-12 to 2026-09-18); CPA held at $21 vs $18. Likely fine, confirm before acting.
Direct conversions grew 5.2x (1.5 to 7.8/day) while paid spend moved 0.73x. Self-reported AI answers went from 6% to 22%. Something untracked is driving buyers.

label: synthetic data
